edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender against the stored owner before setPresalePrice executes
onlyOwner restricts setPublicPrice to the owner identified by msg.sender
addToPresaleList is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
removeFromPresaleList is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 randomness seed inside randomIndex
burn requires ownerOf(tokenId)==msg.sender before burning
mintNFT uses msg.sender as the recipient of minted tokens
presaleNFT uses msg.sender as the recipient of minted tokens
giveAway requires msg.sender == owner()
withdrawAll is guarded by onlyOwner
flipSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner
flipPreSaleState is guarded by onlyOwner
setBaseURI is guarded by onlyOwner
multiBurn is guarded by onlyOwner and checks ownerOf(i) == msg.sender
setWhiteList requires msg.sender == owner()
block.timestamp is part of the pseudo-random seed in randomIndex, creating timestamp dependency
block.timestamp feeds an on-chain randomness computation that miners/validators can influence
_mintWithRandomTokenId calls randomIndex to obtain a token id
randomIndex produces predictable pseudo-randomness from nonce, timestamp and difficulty
mintNFT calls _mintWithRandomTokenId for each token
presaleNFT calls _mintWithRandomTokenId for each token
giveAway calls _mintWithRandomTokenId for each token
_withdraw performs a low-level call forwarding value to an arbitrary address, enabling reentrancy
withdrawAll invokes _withdraw multiple times, performing external calls before final balance handling
Low-level value call transfers funds to FOUNDER_1, an external call target
Low-level value call transfers funds to FOUNDER_2, an external call target
Low-level value call transfers funds to MOONVERSE_NFT_GAMING, an external call target
mintNFT checks the saleIsActive flag
presaleNFT checks the preSaleIsActive flag
mintNFT multiplies public_price by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value
presaleNFT multiplies presale_price by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value
mintNFT bounds total supply by MAX_THEMOONMONSTER
mintNFT subtracts MAX_THEMOONMONSTER_RESERVE from the maximum supply
presaleNFT caps supply by MAX_THEMOONMONSTER_PRE_SALE
presaleNFT limits purchases by MAX_THEMOONMONSTER_PRESALE_PERWALLET
giveAway decrements MAX_THEMOONMONSTER_RESERVE using SafeMath.sub
randomIndex reads and writes the indices swap array
randomIndex increments the nonce counter
addToPresaleList writes true into presalerList
removeFromPresaleList writes false into presalerList
isPresaler reads presalerList
presalePurchasedCount reads presalerListPurchases
setPresalePrice writes presale_price
setPublicPrice writes public_price
setWhiteList writes whitelistURI
flipSaleState toggles saleIsActive
flipPreSaleState toggles preSaleIsActive
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop and price multiplication in mintNFT
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop and price multiplication in presaleNFT
numberOfTokens controls the giveAway mint loop amount

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter limit is only used to write presale_price inside setPresalePrice
Parameter limit is only used to write public_price inside setPublicPrice
Parameter entries is iterated to populate presalerList inside addToPresaleList
Parameter entries is iterated to clear presalerList inside removeFromPresaleList
Parameter tokenId is the sole argument used for ownership check and _burn in burn
Parameter numberOfTokens drives supply checks, payment checks and mint loop in mintNFT
Parameter numberOfTokens drives wallet limit, supply checks and mint loop in presaleNFT
Parameter numberOfTokens bounds the giveaway loop and reserve decrement in giveAway
Parameter to is the mint recipient passed to _mintWithRandomTokenId in giveAway
Parameter startTokenId initializes the burn loop in multiBurn
Parameter endTokenId bounds the burn loop in multiBurn
Parameter _whitelistURI is directly stored into whitelistURI in setWhiteList
Local totalSize is computed and consumed entirely inside randomIndex
Local index is the derived pseudo-random index used only inside randomIndex
Local value stores the swap lookup result and is returned from randomIndex
Local _tokenID holds randomIndex output and is immediately used for _safeMint
Local entry is the loop element validated and stored into presalerList
Local balance holds the contract balance split among founders and owner in withdrawAll
